notes: An upgraded guard post now launches drones with spinning rotors, from a new guard hut with a drone pad on its roof.
Blueprints of unbuilt buildings match the size of the finished building, and a locked grow dome shows as a blueprint with its unlock pad.
Carried goods stay in workers' arms, operators face their machines, and machine upgrade pads say what they upgrade.
Raid flags point to where attackers will actually enter, and the gate meter shows one dash per wave.
Stepping on a hire pad with no free settlers now says so straight away.
The field guide shows the current models, and pickaxes now strike blade-down.
